**Comparability check:** Both figures come from the same filing and cover 12‑month fiscal years ended June 30, presented on a consistent consolidated basis (FY2023 is shown as the comparative period within the FY2024 10‑K), so the two periods are directly comparable [DOC-1].

**Calculation**

| | FY2024 | FY2023 |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | $245,122M [DOC-1] | $211,915M [DOC-1] |
| Cost of revenue | $74,114M [DOC-1] | $65,863M [DOC-1] |
| Gross profit | $171,008M | $146,052M |
| Gross margin | 69.76% | 68.92% |

- FY2024: ($245,122M − $74,114M) ÷ $245,122M = 69.76% [DOC-1]
- FY2023: ($211,915M − $65,863M) ÷ $211,915M = 68.92% [DOC-1]

Gross margin **improved** by approximately 0.84 percentage points, as revenue grew ~15.7% while cost of revenue grew a slower ~12.5% [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.8 percentage points (68.92% in FY2023 to 69.76% in FY2024)
